oracle: Independent Arrow/NumPy aggregates and Python SHA3 framing over every typed input value.

protocol.execution: sequential balanced rotation, isolated persistent worker processes
protocol.settings: 4096-byte pages, WAL, FULL, 64 MiB connection cache, memory temp tables, mmap off, one SQL worker
protocol.query_timing: prepare and CREATE TEMP TABLE AS SELECT; validation and hashing excluded
protocol.maintenance_cycle: 100 committed updates + affected grouping query + complete patch merge/commit + truncating WAL checkpoint; exact fixture restoration excluded
protocol.index_policy: SQLite retains all original workload indexes; SQLNEW adds only the time or top-two index, because native grouping does not require a persistent grouping index
limits: One Windows machine; warm single-connection results.
Temporary SQL sorting follows the connection temp-store setting; native hash state is capped.

datasets.description: H2O group cardinalities and value distributions; NumPy PCG64 seed 108, not R-identical rows; K=100, no NULLs, unsorted.
adaptations: 1,000,000-row default instead of the original minimum 10,000,000; configurable.
Portable SELECTs materialized into a temporary table; deterministic result ordering added.
q6 (median/stddev) and q9 (correlation) are reported unsupported by both SQLite configurations and SQLNEW.
indexes: CREATE INDEX tuned_top2 ON t(id6,v3 DESC)
